rules.Low: Big (over $50M), single-asset pools on trusted lenders, savers or SOL staking. Yield at most 12% and close to its 30-day average. No hack in the last year.
rules.Mid: Smaller or younger pools, real-world-asset tokens, perps pools (JLP, HLP), stable-stable LP, pools where most of the yield is reward tokens.
rules.High: Volatile LP pools (impermanent loss), 20%+ a year, pools under $5M, leverage, yield spikes above 2.5x the 30-day average, anything hacked in the last year.
